prompt.spicy:
One behaviour, thirty days. A Cue and a Behaviour, not a goal — vague intent has a measured effect of roughly nothing, if–then plans don't.

Pick one of ours or write your own. Small enough that you'd still do it on a bad day.
prompt.boardroom:
One behaviour, thirty days. A Cue and a Behaviour rather than a goal: general intention has minimal measured effect, whereas if–then planning does not.

Select one of the suggestions or write your own, small enough to complete on a difficult day.

cue.spicy: When I'm about to ask a question
cue.boardroom: When I am about to ask a question

behaviour.spicy: I add the assumption I'm working to and what I'll do by default if nobody replies
behaviour.boardroom: I state the assumption I am working to and the action I will take absent a response

cue.spicy: When I catch myself typing "sorry, stupid question"
cue.boardroom: When I begin a message with an apology

behaviour.spicy: I delete it and start with what I've already done instead
behaviour.boardroom: I remove it and open with the work already completed

cue.spicy: When I don't know how to do something
cue.boardroom: When the method is unclear to me

behaviour.spicy: I give it ten minutes of real looking, then ask with what I found attached
behaviour.boardroom: I spend ten minutes investigating, then ask and include what I found

cue.spicy: When a question occurs to me that isn't blocking anything

behaviour.spicy: I park it in a list and send them together once a day
behaviour.boardroom: I record it and send the accumulated questions once daily

cue.spicy: When I can't say in one sentence what a piece of work is for
cue.boardroom: When I cannot state in one sentence what the work is for

behaviour.spicy: I say that out loud to someone that day, before I build anything on top of it
behaviour.boardroom: I raise it that day, before building further work on the assumption

verdict.spicy: In the tracker. Four check-ins over thirty days, then it ends — properly ends. No streak, nothing breaks if you miss a Tuesday.
verdict.boardroom: Recorded in the tracker with four check-ins over thirty days, after which it concludes. There is no streak and missed days reset nothing.

principle.spicy: Cue → Behaviour. The cue is the part everyone leaves out and the part that does the work.
principle.boardroom: Cue then Behaviour. The cue is the component most often omitted and the one that produces the effect.
